title: Figure 8. The Reverse Energy Bypass Concept (hypersonic vehicle plasma schematic)
description: Color schematic of a hypersonic vehicle profile with a large red curved arrow depicting energy moving upstream, and callout boxes reading "Plasma directed energy steering and lift control," "Magnetically driven surface plasma for boundary layer control," "MHD heat-into-power conversion," "Plasma generated virtual cowl lip," "Plasma energy addition for flow/shock control," and "Plasma enhanced mixing, flame spreading, and ignition control." Captioned "Figure 8. The Reverse Energy Bypass Concept. The red arrow symbolically depicts the general direction of energy bypass – upstream."
